name: color-highlight-v2
description: Highlight web colors in your editor

enumDescriptions: Solid border around the matched token
Color applied to the text itself
Colored underline beneath the matched token
Small colored dot rendered after the token
Small colored dot rendered before the token
colorHighlight.markerType.description: Visual style used to indicate a color match in the editor.

colorHighlight.markRuler.description: Show a colored mark in the overview ruler (scrollbar gutter) for each matched color.

colorHighlight.useARGB.description: Parse hex colors in ARGB order (#AARRGGBB) instead of the default RGBA order (#RRGGBBAA).

colorHighlight.matchWords.description: Match CSS named colors (e.g. 'red', 'blue') in all file types. Always enabled inside CSS/SCSS/LESS/Sass/Stylus files.

colorHighlight.matchRgbWithNoFunction.description: Match comma-separated RGB triplets written without the rgb() wrapper (e.g. '255, 0, 128').

colorHighlight.rgbWithNoFunctionLanguage.description: Language IDs where bare RGB matching is active. Use '*' for all languages or '!langId' to exclude a specific language.

colorHighlight.matchHslWithNoFunction.description: Match comma-separated HSL triplets written without the hsl() wrapper (e.g. '120, 100%, 50%').

colorHighlight.hslWithNoFunctionLanguage.description: Language IDs where bare HSL matching is active. Use '*' for all languages or '!langId' to exclude a specific language.

colorHighlight.sass.includePaths.description: Additional load paths passed to the Sass resolver when scanning SCSS/Sass files for variable definitions.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run build
